title: Screening thermoelectric materials for high-output performance in wearable electronics
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5416-5423
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00216H, Paper
Xinjie Yuan, Pengfei Qiu, Chuanyao Sun, Shiqi Yang, Yi Wu, Yumeng Wang, Ming Gu, Lidong Chen, Xun Shi
|S|/κ and S2σ/κ2 are proposed as more effective indicators than zT for screening thermoelectric materials to develop powerful thermoelectric devices used in the exacting working conditions of wearable electronics and the Internet of Things.
